_note: The twelve of the chapter's 38 Wan 2.2 shots whose first frame shows a strong expression, as looked at frame by frame (5 moments of every shot, face crops at 7 moments, larger crops of the doubtful ones). One take per shot, seed 1, judged by eye, not measured. 'mouth': open = wide open at frame 0; clenched = teeth together or a closed grin; eyes = the expression is in the eyes. 'verdict': relaxed = the expression is gone by the last frame; held = still there at 5 s; between = eased, then partly back. 'crop' is the face box as fractions of the frame (x0, y0, x1, y1). 'askedOpen': the prompt itself asked for an open mouth or jaws.
